function getReserves() view returns (uint256 ethReserve, uint256 sztuReserve)
function getAmountOut(uint256 amountIn, uint256 reserveIn, uint256 reserveOut) pure returns (uint256)
function addLiquidity(uint256 sztuAmount) payable returns (uint256 lpAmount)
function removeLiquidity(uint256 lpAmount) returns (uint256 ethAmount, uint256 sztuAmount)
function swapETHForSZTU(uint256 minSztuOut) payable returns (uint256 sztuOut)
function swapSZTUForETH(uint256 sztuIn, uint256 minEthOut) returns (uint256 ethOut)
event LiquidityAdded(address indexed provider, uint256 ethAmount, uint256 sztuAmount, uint256 lpMinted)
event LiquidityRemoved(address indexed provider, uint256 ethAmount, uint256 sztuAmount, uint256 lpBurned)
event Swap(address indexed user, bool ethToSztu, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOut)
